reference_check.reliability: Finite-sample reference, independent-sequence noise measured; not an exact infinite-bounce solution.

limitations: Static Cornell scene and one camera only; not a relocation flicker or moving-camera test.
20 surface vertices maximum, no RR; finite-path PT rather than infinite-bounce ground truth.
DDGI uses Lambertian albedo/pi. Native StandardMaterial PT uses Frostbite diffuse + GGX; Lambert control explicitly replaces materials in an isolated scene.

Official baseline uses a different point-light falloff, packed probe formats, relocation minimum distance, thresholds and warmup budget. Cross-engine comparison is descriptive, not a controlled integration pass/fail test.
FLIP exposures frozen from the previous official reference for a common viewing range, not refitted to each new scene variant.
Measured DDGI pass includes probe update, screen query and unavoidable pass overhead; excludes GBuffer, UI, file IO and PT.
16,384 warmup frames: checkpoint evolution recorded, no claim of exact convergence.
